method: Assistant directly viewed five source/R3/native comparison PNGs, two move/reopen/reroute sheets, and the eleven-case synthetic source/native contact sheet, all based on PowerPoint 16 renders.
verdict: Useful conservative region feature, not general reconstruction or human-time acceptance.
attention: Four separate upright arrows, no shadow. False gap faces removed, including after moving the target. Text and outlines remain simplified; exact source styling is not claimed.
perceive: False fill fragment removed. Two short paths remain close to source attachment positions, but the final mask/fit simplifies bends and the left route is slightly oblique. The two unstable lower-node labels are blank. Do not claim exact L-path preservation or visually complete text.
hevc: Third label now reads in correct word order; all four node labels remain. Fonts and external Decoding label differ/are missing. Structure is readily recognizable.
blip: Five nodes and three scoped connections persist with thinner lines. Text is small, source outlines are not faithfully retained; one label still merges textdecoder despite two-scale agreement.
reasoning: Four nodes and three links persist, but Decoder and Executor labels are omitted due to scale disagreement. This trades coverage for conservatism, not guaranteed edit-time savings.
ordinary_edit: Endpoints follow resized/moved owners and hidden false gap faces no longer appear. Prescribed downward moves still create overlaps and oblique lines, so the edited layout is not an automatic-layout success.
reroute: Explicit native reroute visibly changes attachment positions in both cases. Owner identity remains, but recovered site arrangement is lost.
synthetic: Three chain scales, vertical chain and elbow retain expected box/link counts in final run; near-white box survives; blank, scatter and unowned arrow outputs are blank; three-way branch retains boxes and abstains on links; neighboring unconnected boxes remain unconnected. Arrow rendering is small at contact-sheet scale. This review and the 11-count contracts do not establish general arrow-direction accuracy.
negative_natural_sample: The large natural plot ROI is rejected by the 4MP resource bound, not classified as a blank successful negative. R4 frozen-scene negative did render blank, which is a separate condition.
